unsupported: Woodsmith of Hilton Head Island operates from Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, where founder Brian Meehan designs and builds custom furniture as a solo woodworker.
The business began from Meehan's passion for crafting furniture and smaller items from wood, though a founding year is not publicly stated.
Each project is custom designed and hand crafted from start to finish using hand-picked furniture-grade lumber, with Meehan working on only one client's project at a time.

Known for: Works on only one customer project at a time; No showroom; direct design collaboration with customers; Each piece custom designed and hand crafted from design to finish; Uses hand-picked furniture quality lumber; Project queue extends months due to exclusive attention
